metadata.title: Cohomology and multiplicative gaps for quasi-isometries of nilpotent groups
metadata.abstract: We construct two word metrics on the same seven-dimensional torsion-free nilpotent lattice whose asymptotic cones are isometric, but for which every quasi-isometry has multiplicative constant at least $1+\varepsilon$, for one fixed $\varepsilon>0$. We use a convex invariant of a fixed quasi-isometry $\Psi:N\to M$. The displacement cocycle of $\Psi$ and the right-invariant means on $N$ determine a compact convex set $\mathcal A(\Psi)\subseteq\operatorname{Hom}(V_N,V_M)$. If $\mathscr G_{\mathrm{pt}}(\Psi)$ denotes the first-layer maps of the graded homomorphisms that occur as blow-downs of $\Psi$ with varying basepoints, then $$ \mathcal A(\Psi)=\operatorname{conv}\mathscr G_{\mathrm{pt}}(\Psi), \qquad\operatorname{Ext}\mathcal A(\Psi)\subseteq\mathscr G_{\mathrm{pt}}(\Psi). $$ For every extreme point $L\in\mathcal A(\Psi)$, the dual map $L^*$ is also the degree-one part of an isomorphism of the full real cohomology rings. This cohomological compatibility, together with the realization of first-layer Pansu differentials by invariant means, yields the multiplicative constant gap stated above.
metadata.comment: 34 pages. This is split off from the authors' previous submission arXiv:2512.06753 . Comments are most welcome!

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.workSummary: 构造同一七维幂零格上的两个词度量，其渐近锥等距而所有拟等距都有严格大于一的乘法常数。
analysis.breakthrough: 展示渐近锥相同仍不足以保证近似等距的定量刚性。
analysis.limitations: 间隙针对构造的七维例子，普遍下界并非摘要结论。 本条数学解读依据官方摘要与评论；论文全文尚未作数学审读，AI 披露另行核查。
